nodes.title: YuE2 Text to Music Generation Guide
widgets_values:
## YuE2 Text to Music Generation Guide

This template uses **YuE2** through the existing **Generate Music** node and **YuE2 Params**. Caption describes the music; Lyrics supplies the words. The default `cot=off` generates without an ABC score.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| url | vLLM-Omni service URL including `/v1`. Default: `http://localhost:8000/v1`. |
| model | Served model name. Default: `m-a-p/YuE2-3B`. Match the running service. |
| caption | Required music description, sent as `instructions`. Describe genre, instruments, mood, vocal language and arrangement. |
| lyrics | Required words to sing, sent as `input`. Use section tags such as `[Verse]`, `[Chorus]` and `[Bridge]`. |
| max_duration_seconds | Duration cap, default 300 seconds. YuE2 accepts 8–360 seconds; converted at 25 frames/s, rounded down. Generation may end earlier. |
| seed | Random seed, default 0; range 0–9007199254740991. Keep all inputs and runtime settings unchanged for repeatability. |
| control_after_generate | Seed behavior: fixed, randomize, increment or decrement. Template default: fixed. |
| response_format | API audio format: WAV, MP3, FLAC or Opus. Template default: WAV. Save Audio independently exports MP3. |
| model_specific_params | Optional MUSIC_PARAMS connection from YuE2 Params, carrying cot and ABC to the service. |
| cot | `off`: no ABC; `melody`: supplied melody score; `full`: supplied score with chord annotations. |
| abc | ABC score text, not a file path. Required for `melody/full`; keep empty for `off`. |

### Usage

Set URL/model to your YuE2 service, edit Caption and Lyrics, then queue the graph. Save Audio previews the output and writes MP3. To condition on an existing score, paste ABC text and choose its matching `melody/full` mode.

### Prompt Writing Guide

Keep Caption focused on genre, instrumentation, vocals and arrangement. Set the vocal language to match Lyrics. Section tags guide song structure without guaranteeing exact timing.
